clues.text: When Jesus fed five thousand, a boy offered five loaves made from it, along with two small fish.
At the threshing floor, Boaz poured six measures of this grain into Ruth's shawl before she went home.
Naomi and Ruth came back from Moab to Bethlehem just as the harvest of this grain began.
Arriving at the Midianite camp, Gideon heard a man's dream of a loaf of this bread knocking a tent flat.
When hail struck Egypt, this crop was destroyed because it was ripe, along with the flax that was in bloom.
Absalom had his servants set fire to Joab's field of this grain so Joab would come see him.
During the famine in Samaria, Elisha foretold that two seahs of it would sell for a shekel at the gate.

taken: Boaz told her to hold out her shawl, then poured six measures of barley into it and placed it on her.
After a night at the threshing floor, he poured six measures of barley into a Moabite woman's shawl.
Elisha foretold that at Samaria's gate, a seah of fine flour would sell for just one of these.
